name: Vanilla syrup
description: One of the most common coffee syrups. It adds gentle sweetness and a vanilla aroma.

name: Caramel syrup
description: Adds sweetness and a caramel tone. It works well with milk-based drinks.

name: Hazelnut syrup
description: A syrup with a hazelnut aroma. It emphasizes nutty notes in coffee and milk.

name: Cinnamon syrup
description: Adds a warm spicy note. It is often chosen for cozy autumn drinks.

name: Raspberry syrup
description: A berry syrup that is usually used in cold drinks.
